entities.summary: William George Maton M.D. was an English physician, a society doctor who became associated with the British royal family. He published on natural history and antiquarian topics. William George Maton was a logicians & mathematicians from Salisbury (1774-01-31, Salisbury–1835-03-30). A moderately significant entity in the historical record.
